icebreakers.title: Start Conversation (Icebreakers)
icebreakers.description: Phrases to break the ice and start first communication on social media or messenger.

phrases.text: Hi! I saw your comment under [post/event name] and I completely agree with you. How do you feel about this [event] in general?
Hi! Your profile looks very interesting. I especially liked the photos from [place]. Do you travel often?
So, I decided to take a risk. Hi! You have an amazing smile, and I couldn't help but write. Hope you don't mind such a direct approach?
Hi! I think we might have crossed paths at [event name]? In any case, you look familiar and very positive :)
Listen, I have a silly question: if you could have any superpower, what would you choose? Hi, by the way :)
I was just thinking about you and couldn't help but smile. How's your day going?
What's the most interesting thing that happened to you today?
I saw something today that reminded me of you and made me smile.
How was your morning? I hope it started as beautifully as you are.
I have a random question for you - what's your favorite way to spend a lazy Sunday?

compliments.title: Give Compliment
compliments.description: Phrases to sincerely and beautifully note something about a girl, her appearance, style or intelligence.

phrases.text: By the way, you have a great sense of humor. Reading your responses is a pleasure.
You look absolutely incredible today. This dress/look suits you very well.
I don't know how you do it, but with each of our meetings I like you more and more. You're amazing.
I really like how you reason. You can talk about anything with you.
Your smile can disarm anyone. Me - definitely.
Honestly? I can't stop thinking about your eyes. You could drown in them.
You have this amazing way of making everything better just by being yourself.
Your smile is absolutely contagious - it lights up my entire day.
I love how passionate you get when you talk about things you care about.
You have such a beautiful mind - the way you think about things fascinates me.

asking_out.title: Invitation to Meet
asking_out.description: Ways to ask a girl out on a date, from casual to very confident.

phrases.text: A new coffee shop [name] opened this week with great reviews. If you have free time, maybe we can check it out?
We communicate so well here, but I'm sure it will be even better in person. Let's meet in a few days? I'm free on [day] or [day].
Enough texting. I want to see you. Tomorrow at 7:00 PM, I'll pick you up. Be ready for a great evening.
If you don't mind, I'd love to treat you to dinner this weekend. You deserve it.
I'd love to take you somewhere special. What do you say to dinner this Friday?
Let's stop talking through screens and meet face to face. Coffee tomorrow?

deepening_connection.title: Deepening Connection
deepening_connection.description: Phrases and questions for more serious and personal conversations to get to know each other better.

phrases.text: What are you dreaming about right now, if you put aside all limitations?
It's very important to me what you think. Tell me honestly, what's most important to you in relationships?
I feel like there's something special between us. Do you feel it too?
What's your warmest memory from childhood?
I want to be with you not only when everything is good, but also when it's difficult. Know that you can always count on me.
Every moment with you feels like a beautiful dream I never want to wake up from.
You're not just my partner, you're my best friend and the love of my life.
I believe in you completely. You've got this, and I'm here for you no matter what.

flirting.title: Flirting and Play
flirting.description: Light, playful and intriguing messages to keep the spark of interest alive.

phrases.text: I just smiled at my phone, and people looked at me strangely. It's all your fault :)
I bet I know what you're thinking about right now? ... About why I haven't written to you yet!
My plans for the evening: 1. Think about you. 2. See point 1. What are yours?
If emojis could blush, mine would be fire truck red after your last message.
I can't concentrate on anything today because I keep thinking about you.
Is it just me, or do we have incredible chemistry?
You're dangerously attractive, and I'm not complaining.
I have a confession: I've been thinking about kissing you all day.

good_morning_night.title: Good Morning / Good Night
good_morning_night.description: Pleasant messages to start or end her day with thoughts of you.

phrases.text: Good morning! I hope your day will be as sunny as your smile.
I woke up thinking about you. May your day be easy and productive!
The only thing that would be better than wishing you good morning via text is saying it to you in person. Have a great day!
Sweet dreams! Rest well.
May you have the sweetest dreams. Hugging you mentally.
I would really like to be with you right now. Fall asleep thinking that I miss you very much. Good night.
Good morning, beautiful! Hope your day is as amazing as you are.
Waking up thinking about you is the perfect way to start any day.
Sweet dreams, gorgeous. Can't wait to talk to you tomorrow.
As you drift off to sleep, know that you're the last thing on my mind and the first thing I'll think of tomorrow.
